criterion.freeze_scope_rule: menu_m_b (default; REQ-17 'frozen choice per (menu, M, B) cell', DRAFT section 7.2, L15 (6) 'k per (cell, c_d/c0)'): one rule and one k per cell, chosen on the equal-weight average of the two conventions' per-replicate criteria (the draws are shared, so the pairing and the paired MC SE hold) and used under both conventions, so REF LQ32's 'both conventions agree' compares one policy; menu_m_b_convention (switch; the builder's first reading, verifier B-1): each convention chooses its own rule and k. The equal weight per convention is a builder reading for REQ-21 (h) and (k); the lead rules
criterion.g_rule: G(pick) = U(keep) - U(pick) in truth; keep scores 0; a truly infeasible pick scores 0 and is a violation (FOCUS 2 Oct convention)
criterion.k_rule: per (menu, M, B, c_d/c0) (freeze_scope): the diagnostic's k with the largest E[G(pick)], also averaged with equal weight over the main quality grid and the cost conventions (and over rho when rho_average_for_rule is true: W1-14 item 4, the rule and k by the same criterion); a tie goes to the larger k
criterion.rule: per (menu, M, B) cell (freeze_scope): the runs-only rule with the largest E[G(pick)], equal weight per (shape, size) grid point, per tau_O point and per cost convention, at sigma central and rho = 0 (the rho average only with A7); a tie (the paired difference below 2 Monte Carlo SE under common random numbers) goes to the simpler rule (one_shot, halving, bisection)

hetero.rule: one option other than keep per replicate (key selector.hetero) gets total seed SD 2 sigma with the shared part unchanged; report only

parameter_uncertainty.rule: fixed (default): the noise parameters are the point values above; posterior_2df (switch): per replicate (key selector.params) the O and L seed SDs are drawn as s sqrt(df / chi^2_df), carrying their 2-df uncertainty (ADD L16's caveat) into the predictions; the U SD stays 2.65 / 3.85 (L15 (1))

model.phi_note: a phi-trial sees G x phi^kappa (an assumption; unused while the phi grid is {1})
model.rho_note: rho = the same-seed correlation of two options' U (a shared seed shift of SD sigma sqrt(rho)); the default grid {0} is L15 (1) in force; {0, 0.67} sits behind the switch until the lead adopts A7 (W1-14 items 1 and 4; RC-18); 0.67 is PREREG section 2's pre-Gate-B low scenario, not a fitted value; with the switch the rule and k are chosen at rho = 0 unless rho_average_for_rule is true (then on the equal-weight rho average, verifier S-10); adopting A7 also adds rho_0.67 to the sensitivities

true_effects.rule: the options' true O and L effects against a0 (L15 (2): default 0); O(option) = O(a0) + its effect; feasible at tau_O if O(a0) + effect - O(theta0) <= tau_O; feasible on L if its effect - the reference's effect <= tau_L

model.u_a0_source: the mean U of a0 1101-1103 (Gate A; sim_w2_out line 10); a constant that cancels in every estimate
model.u_sampling_source: sim_w2_out line 37 (the a0 per-arm sampling variance at 200 prompts x 3 samples, Gate A); a C-lean run has 1 sample per prompt (3 x the variance); a psi-subsample has v / psi
model.u_seed_sd_source: PLAN-S:117 (the per-arm SD of the three Gate A a0 seeds, 2 df, and its high case); never the Gate B noise-gate value (L15 (1))

uo_correlation.rule: in force (brief REQ-17): the U-O correlation from Gate A's a0 seeds: the Pearson correlation of the three per-seed U and O values (1 df, close to no information, EXTR section 10 item 8); mode fixed uses fixed_value; the grid {0, 0.5} is a proposal that needs the lead

name: selector_simulate

category.rule: one winner: a uniform option (key selector.effects) gets the size, the others 0; spread: the size times Dirichlet(1, ..., 1) shares (the same total, drawn from the same key); equal weight per (shape, size) point (L15 (1))

planted.group_effect_note: a group trial (bisection) has the sum of its cells' true effects (additivity) and a single run's noise (an assumption; verifier S-9). A dose term proportional to the rows removed cancels in bisection's descent (the two halves hold equal rows at M = 8 and 32; 37 against 38 rows at M = 128's last level) and in every comparison between cells of one menu; it enters a rule's E[G] only as dose x the cell's rows x the rule's probability of picking an option other than keep. So it cannot make a group trial a difference of two large numbers in this model; that needs a non-additive group effect or a noise that grows with the rows removed, whose form and size (never from a Gate B outcome) the lead names
planted.rule: the plant's cell (key selector.plant: a uniform unit, then a uniform 37-row leaf in it, the ADD L12 (5) rule with no oversize rows) gets the size at every M; every other cell gets the background (default 0); equal weight per size point

category.rule: score = G + r s z, s = the SD (ddof 0) of the true G over the options other than keep in that replicate, z iid N(0, 1) (key selector.diagnostic); uninformative = a sealed random order (key selector.uninformative), also used when s = 0; SIM2 (report only): the true best is ranked first with probability 0.5 (key selector.sim2), else it is never first

planted.rule: a row-level model: the 37 plant rows score N(mu, 1), every Dolly row N(0, 1) with no signal (key selector.diagnostic, one draw per row); mu = sqrt(2) Phi^-1(AUC); a cell's score = the mean of its rows' scores; report-only sensitivity: G + r s z with z the cell's standardized row sum

replicates.rule: brief REQ-17 default 20,000 per cell; L15 (9): if the full grid is too slow on CPU, a smaller count for the diagnostic grid with the paired MC SE reported
